call.advice.low: No check is perfect. Scammers change their scripts. If anything feels wrong, hang up and verify.

dc.cooldown.note: Urgency is the scammer's main tool. A real office will still be there in a minute.

dc.item3: Tell someone you trust who is next to you.

reason.asks_id_details: It asks for Aadhaar, PAN or bank details.
reason.asks_secret_code: It asks you to share or send a code, PIN or password. Real banks never do this.
reason.authority_claim: It claims to be from the police, CBI, customs, a bank or another authority.
reason.callback_number: It asks you to call or message an unknown number.
reason.easy_money: It promises easy or guaranteed money.
reason.has_link: It contains a link. Do not open links you did not expect.
reason.impersonated_brand_action: It uses a known brand name with a suspicious link.
reason.install_app: It asks you to install an app or a remote-access tool.
reason.kyc_demand: It demands a KYC, PAN or Aadhaar update.
reason.model_pattern: The wording looks like scam messages seen before.
reason.no_flags: No warning signs were found in the wording.
reason.ok.official_channel_wording: It points you to official channels.
reason.ok.tells_not_to_share: It warns you not to share the code.
reason.ok.transaction_notice: It looks like a normal transaction notice.
reason.payment_request: It asks you to pay or transfer money.
reason.prize_claim: It promises a prize, lottery or free gift.
reason.secrecy_or_isolation: It tells you to keep this secret or stay on the call.
reason.short_or_odd_link: The link is shortened or looks odd, so you cannot see where it leads.
reason.threat: It threatens blocking, arrest or legal action.
reason.upfront_fee: It asks for a fee before giving a loan, job or prize.
reason.urgency: It pushes you to act immediately.
reason.url.ip_host: The link uses a number address instead of a website name.
reason.url.lookalike_brand: The address imitates a well-known name but is not its official site.
reason.url.many_subdomains: The address has many parts, a common trick to look official.
reason.url.no_flags: No structural warning signs in the link. This does not prove it is safe.
reason.url.plain_http_sensitive: It asks for login or payment on a non-secure (http) page.
reason.url.punycode: The address uses look-alike letters from another alphabet.
reason.url.shortener: It is a shortened link, so the real address is hidden.
reason.url.suspicious_tld: The address ends in a type often used for scam sites.
reason.url.userinfo: Text before an @ sign hides the real website.
report.ch.bank_then_1930.title: Call your bank first, then 1930
report.ch.bank_then_1930.why: You shared a code or detail, so the thief may try to use it. Call your bank and your card or UPI provider right now, using the number printed on your card or passbook. Then call 1930.
report.ch.chakshu.title: Report it on Chakshu (Sanchar Saathi)
report.ch.chakshu.why: Chakshu on the Sanchar Saathi portal is for reporting suspected fraud calls and messages. It is not for money that is already lost: for that, call 1930.
report.ch.cybercrime_portal.title: File on cybercrime.gov.in
report.ch.cybercrime_portal.why: cybercrime.gov.in is the national cybercrime reporting portal, for harassment, fake profiles and other cybercrime, and for filing after a financial fraud.
report.ch.helpline_1930.title: Call the 1930 helpline now
report.ch.helpline_1930.why: 1930 is the national cyber fraud helpline. Speed matters: the sooner you report a money loss, the better the chance of stopping it.
report.ch.tips.title: Good: nothing has happened
report.ch.tips.why: Stay careful. Never share an OTP or PIN, and check any message before you click.
report.disclaimer: This app does not file the complaint for you and cannot recover money. It only guides you to the official channel.
report.offline: No internet right now. Open the portal when you are online. Your checklist stays saved.
report.q.money: Has money been taken from your account?
report.q1.other: Harassment, fake profile or other cybercrime
report.q2: Did you share any OTP, PIN, card or ID detail?
